methodology.marketScope: Public alternatives mapped to Max Booster's creator and music-career workflows.
methodology.evidenceType: First-party official-page metadata retrieved over unauthenticated HTTPS.
methodology.comparisonRule: A competitor statement is a reference claim only. It is not independently validated and is not proof that Max Booster matches or surpasses it.
limitations: The web-search and web-fetch services returned HTTP 402 during this collection, so the snapshot uses directly reachable official pages only.
No customer reviews, paid competitor databases, account-only pages, or platform logins were used.
Claims do not represent an exhaustive competitor census and do not establish feature quality, adoption, or customer outcomes.
DistroKid's public page returned a bot-challenge page during inspection, so no DistroKid claim is included.
Public competitor material is reference evidence only; it is not authorized training data.

areas.title: Studio and media creation
acceptanceCriteria: Create, edit, save, reopen, and export a real user-owned project.
Verify exported audio or media is accessible and playable after reload.

areas.title: Songwriting
acceptanceCriteria: Generate editable, structured songwriting content and retain provenance.
Save, reopen, edit, and export the same project without losing user changes.

areas.title: Music distribution
acceptanceCriteria: Validate a release package and preserve ownership and rights metadata.
Require the configured explicit opt-in before submission and report only provider-acknowledged states.
Measure store coverage only using the same definition and scope as the cited competitor claim.

areas.title: Social content and publishing
acceptanceCriteria: Generate usable content, save edits, schedule it, and recover the scheduled job after restart.
Verify account ownership, platform access, and provider-acknowledged publish outcomes.

areas.title: Outreach and campaigns
acceptanceCriteria: Persist approved recipients, content, consent, and campaign state.
Verify previews and dry runs without sending customer messages; live delivery must use provider acknowledgements.

areas.title: Advertising
acceptanceCriteria: Persist campaign configuration and budget limits before activation.
Verify reporting and attribution from source records; no test may make a live charge.

areas.title: Dashboard and analytics
acceptanceCriteria: Every displayed metric has an account-scoped source and freshness timestamp.
Distinguish zero from missing, stale, or unavailable data.
Compare platform or artist counts only when metric definitions and scope match the reference.
